# chargebee_item_family (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Chargebee product family by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "chargebee_item_family" "existing" {
  id = "legacy-family"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the item family.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the item family.
- `name` (String) Display name of the item family.
- `status` (String) Status of the item family in Chargebee.
